prompt:
COMPLETE HOMEPAGE OVERHAUL & REDESIGN to create an ultra-premium, cinematic Indian travel experience inspired by the immersive visual quality of MP Tourism. DO NOT use generic travel card grids.

1. FULL-SCREEN CINEMATIC VIDEO HERO (HIGHEST PRIORITY):
- The hero occupies the ENTIRE first viewport (100vh) from the very top of the browser.
- A full-bleed cinematic video canvas runs behind everything: header, typography, badges, and CTAs. The video concept portrays ONE continuous journey traversing India: snow-capped Himalayas, ancient Leh-Ladakh monasteries, sweeping Thar Desert sand dunes with camel caravans and golden sandstone forts, Khajuraho temple stone carvings, lit-up Mysuru Palace at twilight, misty Western Ghats waterfalls, Corbett forest wildlife, and serene Kerala backwater houseboats.
- The video has subtle dark edge-scrims (top 30% and bottom 30%) to ensure pristine text readability without dulling the vivid landscape visuals.
- Visual ticker pill in the bottom corner showing the current flight coordinate: 'Currently gliding over: Thar Desert, Rajasthan • 26.9124° N' with subtle scene transition indicators.

2. TRANSPARENT OVERLAY HEADER:
- Sits directly over the video at the top. DO NOT collapse into a tiny floating pill.
- Left: The official BharatVista logo prominently displayed (recognizable brand emblem with the iconic illustrated India landmark map, navy 'Bharat', vibrant saffron 'Vista' with pin, and 'Tours & Travels').
- Center: Premium navigation links (Explore, Destinations, Tours, Experiences, Stories, About) in clean white/cream typography with soft hover glow.
- Right: Distinct high-contrast Sunset Saffron (#EA580C) 'Plan My Trip' CTA button.
- On scroll, transforms into a compact, frosted glass sticky header (#0A2E4C/85 backdrop-blur-md).

3. HERO CONTENT & TYPOGRAPHY:
- Sits grandly over the cinematic video.
- Top badge: 'हर सफ़र एक नई कहानी' in authentic Devanagari calligraphy with a warm saffron accent line.
- Grand Display Headline: 'Discover India, Your Way' in elegant editorial serif (Playfair Display, 64px).
- Atmospheric subtext: 'Journey through living heritage, eternal rivers, snow-crowned summits, and unscripted stories.'
- Dual Action CTAs: Primary Sunset Saffron (#EA580C) 'Explore Tours' button and frosted glass 'Plan My Trip' button.
- Ambient downward scroll beacon.

4. COMPACT FLOATING TRIP PLANNER:
- Docked seamlessly at the transition between hero and content.
- Clean 4-field horizontal console: 'Where do you want to go?' | 'When are you travelling?' | 'How many travellers?' | 'Approximate budget?' | 'Plan My Trip' button.

5. SECTION 01: 'EXPLORE INDIA' (THEMATIC PERSPECTIVES):
- Large panoramic animated experience panels (not small square cards): Heritage & Palaces, Nature & Wilderness, Sacred & Spiritual Journeys, High Himalayas, Living Culture & Cuisine, Epic Road Journeys.

6. SECTION 02: 'PLACES THAT STAY WITH YOU' (FEATURED DESTINATIONS):
- Full-bleed immersive destination reveals (Ladakh, Rajasthan, Kerala, Varanasi, Meghalaya) with atmospheric climate readings, best season badges, and evocative narrative descriptions.

7. SECTION 03: 'EXPERIENCES BEYOND THE ITINERARY':
- Split-screen kinetic panels showing unscripted moments (Dawn boatman on the Ganges, Royal dune dining under Thar stars, Mist-shrouded tea harvesting in Munnar).

8. SECTION 04: 'EVERY PLACE HAS A STORY':
- Premium travel magazine editorial feature in Deep Midnight Navy (#061727) with photojournalism and long-form storytelling vignettes.

9. SECTION 05: 'JOURNEYS MADE FOR YOU':
- Signature handcrafted tour collections with route waypoints, durations, luxury inclusions, and dual actions ('Explore Tour' & 'Plan My Trip').

10. SECTION 06: 'HOW YOUR JOURNEY BEGINS':
- 4-step progressive timeline: 01 Discover → 02 Plan → 03 Connect → 04 Travel.

11. SECTION 07: FINAL CINEMATIC CTA & COMPREHENSIVE FOOTER:
- 'Your next story starts here.' over a breathtaking dusk vista + full footer with official logo, directory links, concierge hotline (+91 1800-BHARAT), and trust credentials.

All components architected for future dynamic CMS/database population.
